{"holdings": {"identity_key": ["cusip", "title_of_class", "other_manager", "put_call"], "description": "Each Form 13F Information Table row is uniquely identified by the composite (CUSIP, TITLE OF CLASS, OTHER MANAGER, PUT/CALL). CUSIP alone is NOT unique because: (1) the same issuer can have multiple share classes with the same CUSIP root but different TITLE OF CLASS (e.g. 'CL A' vs 'CL C'); (2) multi-manager filings list the SAME security multiple times with different OTHER MANAGER codes (e.g. blank vs '2') and different voting-authority breakdowns; (3) the same equity can appear as both an equity row and a PUT/CALL options row. Including all four components is necessary for stable alignment across extractors."}}
